vision.name: TaskFlow
vision.description: TaskFlow is a real-time collaborative task management platform for small teams. It provides workspaces, projects, and tasks with SSE-based live updates, file attachments, and Slack notifications.
vision.problem_statement: Teams lose context across tools and miss deadlines because task management is fragmented.

pages.name: Dashboard
pages.description: Overview of all projects and recent tasks

components.name: RecentTasksFeed
components.description: Live feed of recent task updates

shared_components.name: TaskCard
shared_components.description: Reusable task card for lists and grids

frontend.design_notes: Data-dense dashboard with sidebar navigation. Use shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS. Dark mode first. Typography: Inter. Accent color: indigo-500.

clients.description: Main API client for the TaskFlow API

methods.name: register
methods.example: const user = await client.register({ email: 'a@b.com', password: 'secret', name: 'Alice' });

typescript_types: export interface User { id: string; email: string; name: string; createdAt: string; }
export interface RegisterInput { email: string; password: string; name: string; }

shared_types: export type ApiError = { code: string; message: string; };
sdk.auth_pattern: JWT Bearer token stored in memory (not localStorage). Injected via Authorization header on all authenticated requests.
sdk.base_url_config: Pass baseUrl to constructor or set VITE_API_URL environment variable.

adrs.title: Go for the API service
adrs.context: We need a performant, typed API that can handle concurrent SSE connections efficiently.
adrs.decision: Use Go with the gin framework for the API service.
adrs.rationale: Go's goroutines handle SSE fan-out well. gin is minimal and fast. sqlc gives type-safe SQL without an ORM.
consequences: No ORM magic — SQL is explicit (this is a feature)

architecture.system_diagram_description: Single Go API service behind a load balancer. PostgreSQL as primary store. React SPA served from CDN. SSE connections maintained to API for live updates.

infrastructure.scaling_notes: API scales horizontally. SSE requires sticky sessions or a pub/sub layer (Redis) if multi-replica.
